title: Fabulous!
text: Experience was very good. Lots of sights and History was shared by our guide. He was very helpful as this was our first time on a Segway. We would definitely book again!
author: 950loriec

title: Philip made our family cruise stop in Barcelona unforgettable
text:
Our family booked this tour last-minute—just an hour before the start time—during our limited port stop as cruise ship passengers. Because we were in a rush, we didn't realize that under-16s aren't legally allowed to ride Segways on the streets.
However, our guide Philip was absolutely fantastic. During the training session, he was incredibly accommodating and let my little cousin try out the Segways in a safe area so that he didn't feel left out at all.

title: First experience and impact
text:
My first-ever Segway experience in Barcelona was absolutely fantastic and so much fun!
The guide (Philip) was friendly and helpful, making us feel confident and safe throughout the ride. A brilliant way to explore the beautiful city, see the sights and create unforgettable memories. Highly recommended!
author: Christina_O

title: Highly recommended
text: Philip’s explanation of Barcelona’s history was both fascinating and informative. He was very thorough in teaching us how to use the Segway and paid close attention to safety throughout the tour. Highly recommended!
author: lynnp1719

title: A great fun way to explore Barcelona
text: U16s can’t use the segways on the streets. Philip was great with our 11yo who was naturally very disappointed not to be able to do it. She could have a good go on the park however and enjoyed the e-bike so it all worked out well!!
author: Candice_T

title: Awesome Segway Pvt tour.
text:
Booked a Pvt tour for my 20yr old son and I(57yo). 
We wanted a streamlined tour with not much stopping with the usual history stops that we had already done. Philip our guide was awesome!!! He tailored a route specifically that suited our needs. He was very  informative and showed us part of the city we couldn’t  have done other wise. I highly recommend this company and Philip especially. So ask for Philip. He’ll show you the way around town. 
If we come back, we’ll definitely try a different route with Philip.
author: Joel_M

title: Fun and informative
text: We had a blast! My husband was very nervous about getting on a Segway and we are both seniors. But he handled it like a pro as soon as he got on and it was very easy. A wonderful and fun way to see this great city!
author: Colleen_K

title: Our guide was very...
text:
Our guide was very friendly and very knowledgeable. The Segway was super fun to use and very easy. Barcelona is a wonderful city and this was a lovely and unique way to see it!

Would recommend without hesitation!
author: Peter_B

title: Three hours well spent
text: Did a 3 hour tour with Philip. It was one of the best tours I have had. Got to see some areas off the beaten path and got an incredible overview of Barcelona history.
author: Scott_W

title: Solo tour
text:
Fantastic trip! Pablo was very knowledgeable and very helpful. This was my first time riding a Segway and I felt like he was checking in on me as needed and helpful overall.

I did the 2-hour tour and think that it was the perfect length. If you've never been on one before, you definitely need at least 5-10 minutes just to get used to maneuvering properly. Overall, I would highly recommend it.
